channel.title: UN Women News and Stories
channel.description: Latest news, high-level panel announcements, and statements from UN Women.

item.title: UN Women at the 81st session of the UN General Assembly (UNGA 81)
item.description: New York: UN Women participates in the 81st session of the UN General Assembly focusing on gender equality, women's empowerment, and multilateral cooperation.

item.title: Speech: You gave us a mandate that has never been more relevant; and every day, together, we make it real
item.description: Remarks delivered by UN Under-Secretary-General and UN Women Executive Director Sima Bahous during the opening of the second regular session 2026 of the UN Women Executive Board, UN Headquarters.

item.title: Speech: The progress shared from your own countries demonstrates what national leadership, strong institutions, and sustained partnership can achieve
item.description: Remarks by UN Under-Secretary-General and UN Women Executive Director Sima Bahous during the closing of the second regular session 2026 of the UN Women Executive Board, UN Headquarters.

item.title: Nepal floods: 43,000 women and girls need immediate humanitarian assistance
item.description: Kathmandu: UN Women briefing on urgent relief operations and emergency support for affected women and girls in Nepal.
